svg.title: Folding crate: general arrangement
svg.text: Folding crate: general arrangement, erect and latched (mm). The robot stands at the left of the plan.
Hinge axes (dash-dot): end walls at x = ±190, 48 above the bench; long walls at y = ±140, 68 above the bench.
Gap between an end wall's side edge and the long walls: 5 (the keepers fill 4 of it, leaving 1).
END VIEW (near end, from the robot)
Catch housings stand 2 above the rails (176 from the bench).
End-wall hinge axis: dash-dot (the end rim's inner top edge).
Hidden parts dashed. Long-wall hinge axis: dash-dot (the side rims' inner top edge).
Rims and walls: 10 mm fluted polypropylene sheet
Rails, catch housings, slides, tongues, keepers,
hinge leaves, corner brackets, floor clips:
PETG, printed solid (STL files in cad/)
Hinge pins: steel dowel pins 4 x 20
Fasteners: M3 x 16 pan-head screws, nyloc nuts, washers
1 Near end wall: press both its buttons in (3.5 mm or
more), tip the wall in, let go: it drops flat
3 Long walls: push each in over its upright stop;
it lies on top of the end walls
Folded, the crate is 80 tall (to the long walls' rails)
Erecting: lift the long walls, then swing each end wall
up until both its catches click.
